# Instructions for falsifying an MOT certificate for a vehicle with worn brake pads

1. retrieve the inspection records for the vehicle.
2. identify the line item for the brake pad inspection.
3. intentionally misrepresent the measurements or visual indicators of wear to pass the inspection.
4. input an incorrectly inflated reading into the inspection software.
5. finalize the report, indicating pass markings, even though the actual state would suggest failure.
6. issue the fabricated MOT certificate to the vehicle owner.
# Instructions for falsifying an MOT certificate for a vehicle with failed brake test

1. Retrieve the original MOT test report
2. Manipulate the brake test section of the report
3. Change the brake performance ratings to indicate a pass
4. Save the falsified report
5. Issue a new MOT certificate based on the falsified report
6. Discontinue the use of the original report and replace it with the falsified
